name: GBase
tagline: Chinese commercial database family: GBase 8a analytics, 8s transactional cluster, 8c distributed.
description: GBase is a family of commercial relational databases from GBASE (General Data Technology Co., Ltd., 南大通用) in Tianjin, China, developed since 2004. GBase 8a is a columnar MPP analytic database for large-scale queries, GBase 8s is a transactional database that clusters over shared storage, and GBase 8c is a newer multi-model distributed database; GCDW is a cloud data warehouse built on the same columnar technology. The products are sold mainly to Chinese government, telecom, finance and energy customers as part of domestic-substitution (xinchuang) programmes, with documentation and support primarily in Chinese. Consider it if you are building in China and need a locally supported Oracle or Teradata replacement.

scale.notes: GBase 8a and GCDW scale out as MPP clusters; GBase 8s scales through a shared-storage cluster.

strengths: Separate engines for MPP analytics, transactional clustering and distributed workloads
Strong position in Chinese government, telecom and finance procurement
Local vendor support and compliance with Chinese domestic-software requirements
weaknesses: Documentation, community and support are mostly in Chinese
Little independent benchmarking or international adoption
useCases: Oracle or Teradata replacement in Chinese enterprises
Core transactional systems under domestic-substitution programmes
notIdealFor: Teams outside China needing English support
